strategy.summary: Two tests have regressed since 0610e02. The new '12.50 USD' output of formatPrice is a deliberate change (26dcac5, PR #99, CHANGELOG 1.1.0, README), so that test is updated with every assertion kept. shippingFor(5000) now returns 499 because the 'refactor' in 28e7c8e (PR #99) replaced `>=` FREE_SHIPPING_FROM with `subtotal > b.over`. That is a side effect the commit says it doesn't have, so that test is kept as it is, marked it.fails, recorded as a defect and filed.

defects.title: Orders of exactly $50 no longer ship free
defects.description: Expected: shippingFor(5000) is 0, because orders costing FREE_SHIPPING_FROM (5000) "or more" ship free (src/shipping.js doc, AC2). Actual: it returns 499. The cause is commit 28e7c8e "Move the shipping rates into a table" (PR #99). That commit is a refactor that says it changes nothing anyone pays, but it replaced `subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_FROM ? 0 : FLAT_RATE` with `RATES.filter((b) => subtotal > b.over).at(-1)`. With the strict `>`, the band { over: 5000, rate: 0 } no longer applies at exactly 5000. The FREE_SHIPPING_FROM constant and its doc are still there, unchanged.
defects.evidence: AssertionError: expected 499 to be +0 // Object.is equality, in test/shipping.test.js › shippingFor › ships free from $50. It failed in all 5 reruns, and the bisect puts the first failure at 28e7c8e.

culprit.subject: Show prices with their currency code
culprit.body: Finance asked for the ISO currency code on every price we show (12.50 USD rather than $12.50), so invoices read the same in every market. This is the new format on purpose; the changelog says so.
culprit.author: TestForge eval
culprit.diff:
diff --git a/CHANGELOG.md b/CHANGELOG.md
index 69aa252..a3b2055 100644
--- a/CHANGELOG.md
+++ b/CHANGELOG.md
@@ -1,5 +1,10 @@
 # Changelog
 
+## 1.1.0
+
+- Prices are shown with their ISO currency code after the amount (`12.50 USD`, no longer `$12.50`), so
+  invoices read the same in every market. `formatPrice` takes the currency as its second argument.
+
 ## 1.0.0
 
 - Price an order's lines and its shipping, and format prices for display.
diff --git a/src/money.js b/src/money.js
index ed28740..40cc5fd 100644
--- a/src/money.js
+++ b/src/money.js
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
-/** A price in cents as customers see it, such as `$12.50`. */
-export function formatPrice(cents) {
+/** A price in cents as customers see it, with its currency code: `12.50 USD`. */
+export function formatPrice(cents, currency = 'USD') {
   if (!Number.isInteger(cents) || cents < 0) throw new RangeError(`Not a price in cents: ${cents}`);
-  return `$${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)}`;
+  return `${(cents / 100).toFixed(2)} ${currency}`;
 }
